_: 40 (capture, span) pairs with the verdict the one verbatim rule gives (ADR-016, criterion 3): the span, trimmed of SPACES only, is a case-insensitive substring of the capture, with no other normalisation. tests/r2f/verdict.test.ts asserts isVerbatim on every pair; scripts/ci/checks/js-sql-parity.mjs (schema:local) asserts public.is_verbatim on the same pairs. Upper-case letters are ASCII only: the embedded database's lower() is not the production locale's (the production-locale property test is R10a).
